item.title: 🗞️ THIS WEEK AT JLT
item.description:
A quick round-up of what’s been happening at JLT this week, including industry news, supplier updates, destination inspiration and the latest additions to our Travel Collection.
If you’ve missed anything since Monday, here’s what we’ve covered.

The JLT Team 💛
